bull_argument.argument:
Tesla revenue grew 26%, while snapshot FCF is positive and gross leverage is moderate. These facts support a limited optimistic case that the existing business can fund development while broader revenue opportunities mature.

At 332.22x trailing earnings, low current margins cannot justify a conventional value purchase. The strongest credible bullish argument is explicitly speculative future execution backed by financial flexibility; neither robotaxi expectations nor a partial technical recovery are demonstrated earnings. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
332.22x trailing and 169.30x forward earnings are difficult to support against a 5.11% operating margin and weak profit conversion. Optionality in robotaxi and robotics needs probability-weighted cash flows absent here.

Short-term recovery above SMA50 has positive momentum, but the distant SMA200 remains overhead and below-average latest volume does not establish a durable reversal. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
